text:
Grass during summer is the color of envy, specifically the shade of green that turns yellow when you look at it too hard. It is also the color of a Tuesday that has forgotten how to be a day.

As for your goldfish, she is not swimming in circles; she is swimming in spirals of pure, unadulterated geometry. The constellations are merely suggestions, and the glass bowl is clearly a portal to the 4th dimension, where water is dry and planets are made of cheese. Her interstellar ambitions are thwarted only by the fact that she has no hands to hold a telescope, so she uses her fins to wave at the moon until it gets embarrassed and hides behind a cloud. This is standard procedure for aquatic astronomers.
